text:
marie: Nightly linkcheck failed for localized site: fragment missing /en-GB/tutorial/#deploy-screenshot

alex: saw it. Generated HTML has id `deploy-screenshot-1` but link points to `#deploy-screenshot`. Likely slug dedupe when same image name exists across locales.

sam: CI excerpt: ERROR: Fragment not found: /en-GB/tutorial/#deploy-screenshot
ERROR: Internal redirect: /tutorial/ -> /en-GB/tutorial/ (redirect loop)

priya: redirect part is a config mismatch (site_url trailing slash + mkdocs-i18n + redirects). Quick fix: normalize site_url in mkdocs.yml (no trailing slash). For fragments, short-term we can relax linkcheck to accept `(-\\d+)?` suffixes.

marie: plan: 1) land linkcheck tolerance to unblock CI, 2) add a lint that warns about duplicated auto-generated anchors across locale dirs, 3) add contributor note recommending explicit anchors for important screenshots (example snippet).

alex: I'll add the contributing blurb in the same PR as the linkcheck tweak.

sam: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/441 "lint: warn on duplicated autogenerated anchors across locales" and a prototype grep-based pre-PR checker.

docs-ci-bot: nightly/docs-linkcheck failed (https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9001) :x: | job: docs-linkcheck | 8m

priya: opening small PR with regex tweak + test. Will follow up with RFC for deterministic id generation if this keeps happening.

marie: thanks everyone. Tag me on PRs and I'll coordinate merge window so release docs aren't blocked. :thumbsup:
